scope: Trendline / Channel / Rising-Falling Wedge / Symmetrical-Ascending-Descending Triangle / Horizontal S-R breakouts, bullish and bearish, crypto perpetual/spot
disclaimer_no_profit_guarantee: Rule-based framework only. Requires walk-forward backtest + real-time demo validation before live capital. No parameter set guarantees win rate.

trendline.definition: single dynamic line connecting >=3 swing highs (descending, resistance) or >=3 swing lows (ascending, support)

channel.definition: two near-parallel lines, upper from swing highs, lower from swing lows
channel.bullish_breakout_condition: close above upper_channel_line while channel_slope <= 0 (descending or flat channel) OR close above upper_line after channel accumulation
channel.bearish_breakout_condition: close below lower_channel_line while channel_slope >= 0 (ascending or flat channel)
channel.note: breakout in direction opposite the prevailing channel slope is weighted higher (trend-exhaustion breakout); breakout in direction of channel slope (continuation) uses standard weights

wedge_rising.definition: two converging upward-sloping lines, both positive slope, upper slope < lower slope magnitude convergence

wedge_falling.definition: two converging downward-sloping lines, both negative slope

triangle_symmetrical.definition: upper line negative slope, lower line positive slope, converging toward apex
triangle_symmetrical.breakout_direction: either, determined by first valid close beyond a line
triangle_symmetrical.apex_proximity_filter: do not score entries within final 10% of triangle length before apex (too tight, low reliability)

triangle_ascending.definition: upper line ~flat (abs slope < 5% of pattern height per bar), lower line positive slope

triangle_descending.definition: lower line ~flat, upper line negative slope

horizontal_sr.definition: flat line from >=3 touches at highs (resistance) or lows (support), tolerance band = touch_tolerance_atr_fraction

retest_confirmation.no_retest_alternative: if aggressive_entry_mode is true, this component is scored 0 and entry_logic.aggressive_entry rules apply instead

multi_timeframe_alignment.counter_trend_breakout_rule: if structure_tf trend opposes breakout direction, do not zero this component; instead require retest_confirmation and volume_confirmation to both score their full max_points, else disqualify

key_level_confluence.condition: breakout level within touch_tolerance_atr_fraction of a prior major HTF swing high/low or round number

recent_failed_breakout_same_level.condition: a breakout attempt at the same line within the last min(10, retest_window_bars) trigger_tf bars already failed (closed back inside structure)

over_extension_without_retest.condition: price extended beyond breakout line by more than max_extension_atr_multiple_without_retest before any retest occurred

scoring_system.final_score_formula: final_score = sum(components achieved points) + bonus_modifiers achieved - penalty_modifiers triggered
scoring_system.entry_decision_rule: consider_entry = (final_score >= entry_score_threshold) AND (no auto_disqualify penalty triggered) AND (risk_management.min_risk_reward_ratio satisfied by planned TP1/SL)

breakout_plus_retest.step_1: on structure_tf, detect and validate pattern per pattern_types + pivot_detection rules
breakout_plus_retest.step_2: on refine_tf, recompute line coordinates with higher-resolution pivots, track price approach to line
breakout_plus_retest.step_3: on trigger_tf, detect breakout candle satisfying breakout_candle_strength criteria
breakout_plus_retest.step_4: on monitor_confirmation_tf, watch for retest of the broken line within retest_window_bars_on_trigger_tf (converted to monitor_tf bars)
breakout_plus_retest.step_5_entry_trigger: enter on close of the first reversal-confirmation candle at retest on monitor_confirmation_tf, OR via resting limit order at broken_line_price +/- 0.1*ATR in the breakout direction
breakout_plus_retest.cancel_condition: if retest closes beyond invalidation defined in scoring_system.retest_confirmation, cancel and mark pattern as failed_breakout for penalty tracking

aggressive_entry_mode.condition_to_allow: final_score computed WITHOUT retest_confirmation component >= (entry_score_threshold + 1.0), i.e. stronger evidence bar required
aggressive_entry_mode.entry_trigger: enter on the close of the breakout candle itself on trigger_tf
aggressive_entry_mode.note: higher win-rate variance; recommend backtesting both modes separately per symbol/timeframe profile before choosing default

entry_logic.monthly_signal_cap: none — frequency is an output of scoring thresholds and asset universe size, not a fixed artificial limit

placement_by_pattern.trendline: beyond the last confirmed swing pivot that formed the broken line, minus/plus buffer
placement_by_pattern.channel: beyond the opposite channel boundary's nearest recent touch, or beyond last swing pivot on the broken side, whichever is closer to entry while still beyond structure
placement_by_pattern.wedge_rising: for bearish breakout: above the most recent lower-high pivot inside the wedge, plus buffer
placement_by_pattern.wedge_falling: for bullish breakout: below the most recent higher-low pivot inside the wedge, minus buffer
placement_by_pattern.triangle_symmetrical: beyond the most recent pivot on the broken side, or 50% retracement of triangle height at breakout x-coordinate, whichever is tighter but still beyond structure
placement_by_pattern.triangle_ascending: for bullish breakout: below the last higher-low pivot of the rising lower line, minus buffer
placement_by_pattern.triangle_descending: for bearish breakout: above the last lower-high pivot of the falling upper line, plus buffer
placement_by_pattern.horizontal_sr: beyond the flat line by buffer, using the far edge of the touch_tolerance band, not the exact line

stop_loss.if_sl_distance_exceeds_max_risk: reduce position size to fit max_allowed_risk_pct_of_account; never widen the structural stop to fit a fixed position size

tp1.definition: pattern_height (max_high - min_low of the pattern on structure_tf) projected from the breakout price in the breakout direction

tp2.definition: nearest opposing major swing high/low or channel boundary on structure_tf beyond tp1

take_profit.if_rr_below_minimum: do not enter regardless of score

trailing_stop.activation_rule: move SL to entry + 0.1*ATR (breakeven+buffer) once price reaches 1.0R profit; begin active trailing once price reaches TP1

structure_based.description: after TP1, on refine_tf, each newly confirmed swing pivot in favor of the trade becomes the new SL reference (beyond that pivot by buffer_atr_multiple)
structure_based.recompute_trigger: on close of each new confirmed refine_tf swing pivot

atr_chandelier.description: alternative/parallel method for the tp3_runner portion

methods.selection_rule: use structure_based as primary; use atr_chandelier trail if structure_based has not produced a new pivot within 2x the structure_tf's typical pivot spacing (fallback to avoid stagnant stop)

pattern_disqualified_if: price already extended beyond max_extension_atr_multiple_without_retest before evaluation
symbol fails asset_universe liquidity/volume filters at evaluation time

backtest_and_validation_protocol.phase_1_historical_backtest: walk-forward test on >=18 months of 1m-1d data across the full asset_universe, per timeframe_profile separately
backtest_and_validation_protocol.phase_2_realtime_demo: minimum 60 signals or 60 calendar days (whichever is longer) on demo/paper account with live data feeds before touching real capital
backtest_and_validation_protocol.phase_3_live_small_size: start at <=25% of intended max_risk_per_trade_pct_of_account for the first 30 live signals
backtest_and_validation_protocol.reoptimization_rule: re-tune atr multipliers and score weights only after >=100 closed signals in a given phase, using out-of-sample data, never in-sample only
